messages:
violet.design: Quick a11y pass on the Activity side-rail (Insights > Model activity). Found a few UX nits when keyboarding + with screen readers. Short repros + suggested fixes below.
sam.frontend: thanks — paste steps and I'll pick up the DOM/ARIA bits.
kai.a11y: top-level: focus management when the rail opens, live region verbosity when events stream in, tappable dot targets for timeline items, and low contrast of status dots in low-light theme.
violet.design: 1) Focus doesn't return to the originating control when closing the rail. I open the activity rail from the model row "Activity" button, close it, and focus lands on page body instead of the original button. Keyboard users lose context.
  repro: Console > Models, press Tab to the row activity button, Enter to open rail, Esc to close rail; observe focus not restored.
  suggested: save the opener element before opening and call opener.focus() on close. Also add `aria-hidden` toggles and `inert` on the main content while the rail is open to trap focus.
sam.frontend: we render the rail as a slide-over; easy to add opener ref and restore focus. I'll wire `inert` on the main content container while rail is visible.
kai.a11y: good. Also ensure the close button is the first focusable element inside the rail to avoid focus getting lost.
violet.design: 2) Live announcements are noisy. When multiple events arrive the SR hears long verbatim text for each new log line, e.g., "[timestamp] tokenized 345 tokens: <full prompt>" — this is overwhelming.
  repro: with live stream running, VO reads each raw log line.
  suggested: summarize announcements with short, stable phrasing and a count: `aria-live="polite"`: "2 new activity events" and provide details in the panel itself. Avoid announcing raw timestamps/payloads.
kai.a11y: exactly. Use an offscreen polite live region that is debounced (e.g., 500–1000ms) and posts aggregate summaries. For high-priority errors use assertive but concise messages like "Inference error: model X".
sam.frontend: I'll replace the inline live region with a summarizer component and debounce the updates.
violet.design: 3) Small status dots (2–4px) used to indicate event severity are too small and low contrast, especially in dark theme. They fail 3:1 and are not easy for pointer targets.
  repro: open rail in dark theme, inspect severity dots next to each timeline item.
  suggested: increase dot diameter to at least 8px, ensure background contrast meets 3:1 for non-text UI, and make the click/tap target 44px with an invisible hit area. Also add textual status via sr-only `aria-label` on the item.
sam.frontend: will bump size and add visually-hidden labels, plus enlarge the hit area with padding.
rachel.qa: I'll add visual regression tests for dark theme and an accessibility check for the hit target size.
violet.design: 4) Timeline items announce as "item" or "entry" in some SRs because the per-item button uses a generic aria-label. Screen reader users need context like "inference completed for model: summarizer-v2, 1m ago".
  repro: NVDA/VO reads just "item", then the timestamp; not helpful.
  suggested: set `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to include the model name and short status. Example: `aria-label="Inference completed for ${modelName}, 1 minute ago"`. Keep labels short.
kai.a11y: prefer aria-labelledby pointing to a visible short heading inside the item (so SR users can inspect the UI), but aria-label is acceptable for concise announcements. Avoid duplicating header text that's already read by the container.
sviolet.design: 5) Keyboard nav: when using Up/Down to move through the timeline, focus jumps to the visual container but not to the actionable control (expand/detail). Keyboard users expect Enter to activate the detail; better to move focus to the primary control inside each item.
  suggestion: make each timeline row focusable (`tabindex=0`) and on focus move virtual focus to the primary action or expose a visible focus indicator on the primary button.
sam.frontend: will implement `tabindex=0` on rows and ensure Enter/Space toggles the detail.
rachel.qa: I'll add an E2E that tabs and then uses Enter to expand 5 items in sequence to validate.
ovan.pm: timeline/priority? which of these are P0?
violet.design: P0: focus restore on close, and live-region debouncing/summary. P1: dot size + hit area, aria-label improvements, keyboard focus behavior.
sam.frontend: I'll split into two PRs: PR-A (focus restore + live-region summarizer) in 4 business days, PR-B (dot size/hit area + aria-label + row tabindex) next week.
kai.a11y: ping me on PR-A for a quick smoke test. I'll draft a tiny checklist for the component docs: "restore focus to opener", "polite live summaries, debounced", "dots meet non-text contrast and target size", "timeline items expose descriptive labels".
rachel.qa: adding tests for focus restore, live region summary, hit size, and SR label assertions.
violet.design: thank you! attaching a couple of screenshots and a short token suggestion for the dark theme dot colors in a follow-up message. :sparkles:
